narrative: On the part. Gaunt's roll is open at the lodging between dinner and the walk back. The speech begins where it has begun since the spring. A line in the margin, in his hand, says what the afternoon does not contain. On the part. He does not open the property chest in his head into the room. The margin note is the whole of the warning. The hat is already on the chair.
